findings.summary: The round-trip-data predicate, the decline cache and the document runner are each new: no existing predicate takes a raw runtime value and rejects the types JSON.stringify rewrites, no existing decline cache keys module/export/args, and the other runModuleJsonSync caller wants a hard failure, so a shared try/catch wrapper would not fit.
The child script reads top to bottom as an async function rather than a nested then-chain with a redundant Promise.resolve.
The document decline caches under the same requireDocument-tagged key the result cache uses, one scheme instead of two spellings.
The Map fixture keeps only the positive proof that the pass lowered to a native Map; a fold to an empty object could not emit one, so the negative assertion added nothing.

The decline cache spawns the child at most once per module, export and arguments; a repeated declining call is instant, and the round-trip walk is a single pass under two percent of the stringify that follows.

The Record return-type name check stays: round-trip validation proves the result shape, not the author's intent to run at generation, so dropping it would execute any out-of-entry static-argument export in a child.
Rejecting a Date or a non-finite number is correct: JSON coerces a Date to a string and NaN to null, and a pass that means the string returns the string and still folds.

The other runModuleJsonSync caller, the canvas-readback data function, shares the silent Map-to-empty-object hazard and bakes wrong pixels with no error; it should validate through the same round-trip check at the runModuleJsonSync boundary and fail loudly, since a readback has no ordinary-lowering fallback.
findings.blockedBy: It is a distinct caller with a distinct response (refuse, not decline) and its own test needs (a canvas paint fixture); calibrating and testing it belongs in its own change.
findings.filedIn: TODO.md (guard the canvas-readback data function against a non-round-trip result)

findings.summary: The Record return-type gate is purely textual, so a shadowed local `Record` over-matches and an index-signature return under-matches.
findings.blockedBy: Resolving the type through the checker is a separate refinement of the gate, unrelated to the decline behavior this change adds, and no reached pass exercises either edge.
